column3: Exact bird-flight counterpart: aerial motion is sustained by divine holding.
The shared sensing triad frames 67:19's invitation to look as accountable perception.
Pairs human blindness with enduring divine sight, without aerial or sustaining detail.
Extends the call to observe created signs and their ordered responsiveness.
Establishes the paired possibility that holding can preserve or withhold provision.
Its creator contrast does not specifically illuminate the bird, holding, or sight scene.
Broadens the observed-creation argument to divine capacity, but not the flight image.
Shows that hearing, sight, and hearts need not yield responsive recognition.
The different human use of holding is too remote from the focal sustaining relation.
A nearby upward gaze at ordered heaven supports the observational setting.
The adjacent scattering-and-gathering movement adds little to the focal aerial sign.
Confinement language is a different holding relation and adds no focal clarification.
Connects looking at a visible renewal with movement toward recognition.
Provides the upper-field counterpoint: what comes from above may harm rather than hold.
Reorients searching sight toward recognizing ordered creation before the bird scene.
General encompassing knowledge only loosely parallels the final divine sight claim.
Makes sight part of a responsible evidential process rather than mere looking.
Universal knowledge across earth and sky is a broad, redundant parallel.
Adds birds in extended formation and a parallel register of divine knowledge.
The preceding upper-field threat is already covered by the closer contrast at 67:17.
A compact instance of divine sight, but without the focal scene's structure.
Another invitation to observe created signs, now without the aerial focus.
Its limit on human knowledge is adjacent context but not an explanation of 67:19.
Preserves a heart-and-sight relation, secondary to the focal external observation.
The divine designation in 67:19 gains a direct lexical parallel, though no scene.
The sensing triad repeats the already supplied perceptual background.
Another general instance of divine sight, without sustaining or aerial content.
Repeats the focal divine designation without adding a relation or scene.
Sharpens the exclusivity of reliance upon the same divine designation.
Future intention is not a usable parallel to the focal observation or holding.
The above/below relation is only a remote spatial parallel.
The adjacent warning contributes context but no distinct focal mechanism.
Keeps visible threat and unseen aid in view, a secondary analogue to unseen support.
Universal encompassing sovereignty is broad and already represented more directly.
Shows sight requiring corrected judgment, but outside the focal created sign.
Its metaphorical holding is a secondary transfer, not the sustaining relation itself.
Formation alone is a thin parallel and does not identify the formed beings.
Completes the nearby holding/withholding pattern with inaccessible water.
General witnessing of all things repeats the final clause at a high level.
The paired names alone add no focused evidence for 67:19.
The demand about the promise is adjacent context, not a reading of the bird sign.
The available link is boundary evidence and the scene does not clarify 67:19.
Cosmic grasp supplies a broad power parallel, not the focal sustaining action.
Joins universal creation with guardianship, directly broadening the sustaining claim.
Its legal use of holding is a different relation and has no focal contribution.
Birds and requested seeing occur, but the scene concerns a different evidential question.
Future compelled seeing is a secondary contrast to the present invitation to observe.
Abundant garden provision does not add to the focal holding or seeing relation.
The Rahman and orderly row are only a distant formal parallel.
An aerial destructive force preserves the contrary upper-field possibility, indirectly.
Directly depicts continuous divine holding against cosmic collapse.
Overhead falling danger is a loose contrary spatial parallel.
Links the focal divine designation with mercy and the question of real protection.
Loss of sight offers a secondary contrast to the focal demand to see.
The above/below punishment image does not clarify the bird or sustaining scene.
Preserves rejection of the focal divine designation as a contrary response.
Explicit divine knowledge of hidden and enacted matters deepens the final sight clause.
Its overhead covering is punitive imagery, not support or observation.
Names the Rahman as the proper object of trust within the immediate sequence.
Its visual comfort setting is unrelated to the focal sign.
Rejection of the Rahman is a distant response parallel without the focal mechanism.
Protects the status of witnessed perception, but in a different scene.
The legal holding contrast does not illuminate the sustaining relation.
Its gradual drawing-in gives only a lexical, secondary holding parallel.
The guidance image is adjacent context but not a distinct account of 67:19.
Deferred seeing is secondary to the focal present act of observation.
All-encompassing knowledge is a broad, redundant parallel to divine sight.
Gathered downfall has no meaningful connection to the focal scene.
Metaphorical holding onto an authority is a distant transfer of the focal verb.
Measured provision with divine sight extends the holding/withholding polarity.
The listed force adds no focal aerial, perceptual, or sustaining relation.
Creation from an origin is too general to clarify the focal sign.
Its comprehensive knowledge conclusion is remote from the bird and holding scene.
The interrogative call to recognize conduct is only a distant perceptual parallel.
Firm attachment is a secondary metaphorical holding relation.
Bird imagery and permission occur, but not the focal flight-and-holding relation.
Aerial birds as a dispatched force preserve the contrary upper-field reading.
Its held-prey relation usefully keeps holding's outcomes from being reduced to preservation.
General divine sight of actions is a broad repetition of the focal ending.
Deferred seeing remains secondary to the focal immediate observation.
A claim to exceptional sight warns that perception can be misappropriated.
Unseen protective care supplies a secondary preservation analogue.
Withholding by hands is a distant, human counterexample to sustaining hold.
Directly pairs prevention of falling with divine compassion, closely paralleling 67:19.
Birds occur within a dream scene, with no sustaining or observational contribution.
Misrecognition of what is seen is a secondary contrast to reading the focal sign.
Bird formation by permission is related but redundant and lacks the focal holding scene.
Divine knowledge of movements through earth and sky complements the final sight claim.
Divine sight of deeds is a general, remote repetition.
Unseen aid offers a secondary invisible-support parallel, but not the focal relation.
The divine attribute alone adds no focused evidence after closer parallels.
Seeing a disputational turning-away is only a distant epistemic parallel.
Mercy after trial is too general to explain the Rahman holding relation.
Its intergroup dispute and judgment do not clarify 67:19.
Known measure alone does not establish the focal sight or sustaining relation.
Seeing only at punishment supplies a contrary, belated-perception parallel.
It adds neither the focal observation nor a distinct supporting relation.
Remembrance and choice do not illuminate the bird, holding, or sight scene.
Performative visibility contrasts loosely with the focal invitation to genuine seeing.
Cosmic observation supports a general evidential method, but not the focal mechanism.
The repeated return of sight immediately before the upper-field sequence sharpens the focal corrective use of looking.
Its aerial projectile image is the missing immediate counterpoint to birds held aloft in the upper field.
Creator-knowledge explicitly links the focal maker and the claim of exhaustive awareness.
The nearby provision sequence broadens the holding/withholding polarity developed by 67:21 and 67:30.
Directly supplies birds in flight as creatures within a divinely ordered, comprehensive relation.
Suspended heavens and ordered celestial motion extend the focal image of sustained order above.
Heavenly supply and permitted travel provide a secondary account of ordered sustaining provision.
Universal praise gives a broader parallel to the bird-praise dimension already present in 24:41.
The guarded sky is a close upper-field counterpart to protection against falling or collapse.
Birds joined with David preserve a distinct bird-and-divine-order reading beyond flight alone.
The cloud and hail scene preserves the contrary possibility of harm descending from above.
The standing of heaven and earth by command is a direct cosmic analogue of sustained aerial order.
Heavens without visible pillars extend the focal inference from visible stability to unseen support.
The possibility of earth swallowing or sky falling supplies a focused contrary boundary to being held.
Birds joined in praise give a parallel bird scene, though without the focal flight mechanism.
Ordered natural responsiveness offers a broad parallel to the focal created sign.
Birds gathered in responsive order add a secondary counterpart to their focal formation.
The near-breaking heavens preserve an upper-field instability contrast to sustaining hold.
A falling heavenly fragment and its misrecognition combine the upper-field contrast with failed seeing.
Hearing and reasoning in the immediate surah context provide a secondary sensorium parallel.
Knowledge of concealed and open matters is a nearby but redundant complement to divine sight.
